mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alerts (id, mold_id, alert_type, trigger_condition, severity, message, status, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{moldId}, #{alertType}, #{triggerCondition}, #{severity}, #{message}, #{status}, #{resolvedBy}, #{resolvedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.mold_id, m.mold_code, m.name AS mold_name, a.alert_type, a.trigger_condition, a.severity, a.message, a.status, a.resolved_by, ur.real_name AS resolved_by_name, a.resolved_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN molds m ON a.mold_id = m.id LEFT JOIN users ur ON a.resolved_by = ur.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT id, mold_id, alert_type, trigger_condition, severity, message, status, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alerts WHERE mold_id = #{moldId} AND alert_type = #{alertType} AND (trigger_condition = #{triggerCondition} OR (trigger_condition IS NULL AND #{triggerCondition} IS NULL)) AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
